# heraut version current

Print the latest released tag.

Print the latest released tag for the strategy, and environment, in .heraut.yml. Pre-release tags are
skipped unless --include-pre-release is given; --bare prints the version without its prefix.

## Usage

```text
heraut version current [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut version current
heraut version current --bare
heraut version current --env prod
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--bare` |  | print the bare semantic version (strip prefix/env/build), not the raw tag |
| `--env <string>` |  | target environment (for per-env strategies) |
| `--force` |  | override safety checks blocking tag promotion or missing PR/MR metadata |
| `--include-pre-release` |  | print the highest SemVer tag including pre-releases (SemVer strategies only; default: latest release) |
| `--json` |  | print the result as a JSON envelope (tag and version) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
